name: @kickside/transform-ui
title: KickSide Transform Assist
description: Reusable, host-injectable web component that negotiates an AI-generated transform for a source->sink mapping. Mounted by tag (kickside-transform-assist) anywhere a mapping is wired.

wippy.description: Reusable transform-builder field (kickside-transform-assist) a host form mounts wherever a source->sink mapping is wired: the user picks a strategy (auto / expression / LLM / code / pass-through), can generate a transform with AI via POST /api/v1/transform/assist, hand-edits it, and edits are auto-validated against the sink via POST /api/v1/transform/validate after a short debounce. All inputs arrive as host attributes: source-schema and sink-schema (JSON strings or live objects), samples (JSON array of real source items), hint (freeform steer for the model), value (an existing { kind, ... } transform to seed the editor for edit-back) and disabled. It emits transform-confirmed with { transform, strategy } on every change, so the host should treat the latest event as the live config and own install/cancel itself (there are no Confirm/Cancel buttons in the component).

source-schema.description: Source item JSON schema (JSON string or object).

sink-schema.description: Sink/endpoint input JSON schema (JSON string or object).

input-shape.description: The sink's declared input shape, record or content; generation and validation shape each output into it.

samples.description: Optional JSON array of real source items to generate/validate the transform against.

hint.description: Optional freeform steer for the model.

value.description: Optional existing transform { kind, ... } (JSON string or object) to seed the builder for edit-back.

transform-confirmed.description: The confirmed transform byte-shape { transform, strategy, rationale } a host writes into state.transform / input.transform.
